name: Full Tilt
blurb: Active:  Rell empowers herself and an allied  champion with bonus movement speed for a few seconds, which is increased when moving towards the empowered ally or an enemy champion.

effects.description: Active: Rell powers up herself and the target allied champion for 3 seconds, both gaining 15% bonus movement speed, increased to 30% while facing the empowered ally or a visible enemy champion.

Additionally, Rell's next basic attack or Shattering Strike within 5 seconds creates an explosion around the target that deals bonus magic damage, capped at 150 - 317.65 (based on level) against monsters and structures.
If cast without a valid target, or self-cast, Full Tilt will automatically target the closest allied champion in range.

notes:
If  Shattering Strike hits more than one enemy, the Full Tilt explosion will be centered around the unit with the lowest Spawn ID.
"Spawn ID" is an unofficial abbreviation to describe the spawn order for all units at the beginning of games.
